confirmed_cause: The test barrier uses a SQLite trace callback that signals before SELECT execution. A competing process can update the row before the SELECT fetches it; the duplicate-claim child then observes None and times out waiting on its queue.
disposition: Root assigned A a bounded test-only fix in tests/test_sqlite_adapter.py and its guide. No product-code defect, completed repair, or passing current gate is claimed.
separate_history: Earlier Docker Hub pull failures remain separate attempts and are not the cause of this run.

raw_log.note: Raw log retained in the shared evidence location; repository ignore rule excludes *.log.
